revenue: Vehicle sales revenue divided by modeled months.
profit: Saved earnings forecast profit divided by modeled months; not recorded profit.
cash: Saved earnings forecast net cash flow divided by modeled months; excludes new financing.
sales: Modeled new and used retail sales divided by months.
front: Vehicle gross divided by retail sales; excludes F&I and service.
holding: Modeled holding costs divided by months.
ad_sale: Total marketing spend divided by all retail sales; not attributed advertising ROI.
conversion: Retail sales divided by all modeled leads, multiplied by 100.
unhandled: Unworked modeled leads divided by months.
fi: F&I gross divided by all retail sales; not product penetration.
ros: Completed modeled service orders divided by months.
ro_gross: Service gross divided by completed orders; not service revenue.
lost_ros: Modeled service demand exceeding capacity divided by months.
payroll: Modeled payroll divided by months. May include burdens unlike the Census reference.
overhead: Modeled operating overhead divided by months; review included expense lines.
overload: Modeled workload above available staffing hours divided by months.
collection: Entered share of scheduled payments collected; an input, not an observed outcome.
default: Entered monthly share of principal defaulting; not an observed delinquency rate.
parts: Not separately modeled. Optional user-entered monthly department total.
collision: Not separately modeled. Optional user-entered monthly department total.

leadership: Review profit alongside cash. Identify which department or working-capital requirement explains the difference.
Test one operational change, then check profit and cash together before committing.
sales: Check volume, vehicle gross and holding costs together. Discounting can move units while reducing earnings.
Test acquisition cost, stock mix or replenishment in a separate saved option.
marketing: Check whether lead-handling capacity can support more advertising. Cost per sale includes organic sales.
Test response coverage or campaign spend separately and compare incremental gross against added cost.
fi: Compare F&I gross per retail unit with volume; this does not measure compliance or product penetration.
Review product mix and training assumptions; rerun the proposal with realistic costs.
service: Separate demand, available technician capacity and gross per order.
Test technician coverage, hours or service capacity; check added payroll against added gross.
people: Lower costs alone are not success. Check service capacity and lost opportunities before cutting staff.
Review department schedules and expense lines, then test the change without reducing required coverage.
bhph: Collection and default percentages are assumptions. Review cash needs and stress-test weaker collections.
Create a downside option with lower collections and higher defaults; compare cash runway before growth.
parts: Parts is not separately modeled yet. Enter a clearly sourced department total and a target without treating it as a simulator output.
Review purchasing, obsolescence and gross with the parts manager; record a measurable action.
collision: Collision is not separately modeled yet. A manual figure remains separate from dealership earnings.
Review cycle time, work in progress and job gross; choose one process change to track.

topics.leadership: Assign compliance oversight, escalation authority and periodic audits.
topics.sales: Check licensing, title/history disclosures, advertised terms and delivery documents.
topics.marketing: Review advertised prices, substantiation, financing disclosures and campaign consent.
topics.bdc: Review contact consent, opt-outs, call recording and outreach rules before automation.
topics.fi: Review credit authorization, lending disclosures, fair treatment and optional-product consent.
topics.bhph: Review servicing, collections, repossession authorization, notices and complaints with a qualified reviewer.
topics.service: Document estimates, repair authorization, safety checks and warranty responsibilities.
topics.parts: Check parts traceability, returns, hazardous materials and warranty documentation.
topics.collision: Review repair authorization, insurer/customer approvals, refinishing hazards and waste handling.
topics.people: Review pay, hours, overtime, training and employment requirements for this location.
topics.facilities: Review premises permits, fire protection, workplace safety and environmental disposal.
topics.accounting: Review reconciliations, tax treatment, record retention and segregation of duties.
topics.technology: Review data access, vendor permissions, retention, incident response and security controls.
